decisions.reason: As a multi-model desk system tightly linked to the firm's core office competence and publicly aligned with flexible workplace interiors, it carries enough sunk development and strategic commitment for management to continue backing it.
The chair family sits close to the established range and benefits from prior standalone presentation, so management is likely to justify continued support rather than admit a mistaken launch.

The floor cushions are more niche and less central to the firm's announced direction, so after several years the commitment effect is weaker and management is more likely to release resources for stronger core and new projects.
The high standing table remains a good fit with contemporary lounge and workplace flexibility, and the earlier investment and visibility make withdrawal less attractive than persistence.

Even though rugs are more distant from the traditional offer, the collection was presented as a flagship direction, and that public commitment strongly encourages escalation of commitment and continued retention.
